propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts on identical inputs (PASS vs FAIL-N-unmet-criteria) minutes apart without code changes, making the close gate unreliable in both directions — spurious blocks and dangerous spurious passes.

The verifier's test-existence judgment is variable and fallible because it relies on free-form LLM search without deterministic decoding, causing false-negative criterion failures when semantic/regex queries fail even though tests exist.

COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars lack recorded verified_at_sha and trace_id, making it impossible to diagnose from stored data alone whether two runs had identical inputs and thus prove genuine non-determinism versus input drift.
Temperature and model sampling are unpinned, allowing per-run variance to flip borderline criteria assessment between upheld and unmet on identical code at HEAD.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT schema must be extended to persist verified_at_sha, trace_id, and model settings (temperature/seed) to enable diagnosability of verifier non-determinism from sidecar records alone.
